divisions.headline: Beach rides big '01 advantage to a critical win over Dart Attack; Jonesing and Element each win big, roll toward the three-week sequence of head-to-head battles among the top 3
Possee hangs close, and then drops the Kids from the B lead in the final 501; Serious, now in 1st, tops shorthanded Inconsist. with a 501 sweep; OnlyDarts put Bottoms in the cellar
Area closes out Projectile in DCkt to maintain their undefeated record; Menace goes full cricket sweep on the Pints; Mafia comes back on the Ducks, ripping off the last 16 straight

Knights knock Point & Rally from the ranks of the unbeaten in a tight battle that went to the last leg; Sanchez swamps Stumble Out in cricket for a solid win; McGavin ekes by the Bandits in 1001 in the head-to-head fight for the #4 spot

Dartness takes a real nailbiter over What's the Point, handing them their first loss, re-starting the E title race; Corks sweep SCkt from Arrows, now find their title hopes even more realistic; Off Constantly tops Mayhem, moves out of bottom-2

The F race redirects itself yet again for what… the 873rd consecutive week?; Two Time never trails Cheap Shots; Down to F drops Death Throw in 1001 (hey, wasn't that exactly the match of the week prediction?); Nein Mark drops 13 slots in the match, but wins anyway because She Said is shorthanded

What the heck has happened in G this last month?! Poof, this is the most amazing race around, by a large margin!; shorthanded Machine hands Bangin their 2nd straight loss; and then We Throw It sweeps 501 from Aim-ing, and vaults all the way into 1st place; three 6-3s and a 6-4 now pack-lead this race

Dirty Darts do Double Vision dirty, yanking them from the unbeatens club!; SofaKings ease past Rangers, re-take the H top spot; the Blind darken the Bright Side, setting up a wk13 showdown with Afraid to possibly decide a bottom-2 spot
